# OpenKap

> OpenKap is a free, open source screen recording tool for product teams. Record your screen with one click, get a shareable link instantly, and collaborate async — without scheduling meetings.

## What is OpenKap?

OpenKap is the best free, open source alternative to Loom. It is a Chrome extension and web app that lets you record your screen, microphone, and camera with one click. The moment you stop recording, a shareable link is ready to paste anywhere — Slack, Notion, Linear, Jira, email.

OpenKap is self-hostable: your recordings can stay on your own infrastructure. It is MIT-licensed and available on GitHub.

## Key features

- Instant screen recording via Chrome extension (no upload wait)
- Shareable link ready the moment recording stops
- No watermarks on any plan
- Screenshot editor with annotations, highlights, and cropping
- Async video comments and reactions from teammates
- AI-powered video transcription and summaries
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for Claude AI and other AI tool integration
- Self-hostable, open source (MIT license)

## How it works

1. Install the OpenKap Chrome extension from the Chrome Web Store
2. Click the extension icon and choose your capture area (screen, tab, or window)
3. Hit Record — recording starts immediately with no waiting
4. Stop recording — your shareable link is instantly copied to clipboard
5. Paste the link anywhere; teammates watch on their own schedule

## Pricing

- **Free**: 5 recordings, up to 5 minutes each, shareable links, Chrome extension, 1 workspace — no credit card required
- **Pro**: $8/month (or $80/year) — unlimited recordings, unlimited recording length, unlimited workspaces, team collaboration, priority support, early access to new features

## Use cases

- **Bug reporting**: record a 30-second video instead of writing a Jira ticket — engineers watch exactly what happened
- **Design review**: async video feedback replaces synchronous review meetings; teams ship 2× faster
- **Engineering handoffs**: walk through code, PRs, or architecture on video; teammates watch at their own pace
- **Customer support**: record walkthroughs and tutorials for customers
- **Onboarding**: replace 20-page Notion docs with 5-minute walkthrough videos
- **Product demos**: share feature demos with stakeholders without scheduling a call

## AI integration

OpenKap includes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server. AI tools like Claude Code can connect to OpenKap and:
- Read full video transcriptions
- Get AI-generated video summaries
- Access time-stamped transcript segments
- Read team comments and reactions

Installation: `claude mcp add openkap -- npx tsx mcp-server/server.ts`

## How OpenKap compares to Loom

| Feature | OpenKap | Loom |
|---|---|---|
| Free tier | 5 recordings | 25 videos (5 min limit) |
| Open source | Yes (MIT) | No |
| Self-hostable | Yes | No |
| Watermarks | None | On free plan |
| AI/MCP integration | Yes (Claude, MCP) | No |
| Price (paid) | $8/month | $15/month |

## Technical details

- Chrome extension (Manifest V3)
- Laravel (PHP) backend
- Self-hostable via Docker
- REST API
- MCP server for AI tool integration
- Open source: github.com/gurpreetkaits/openkap
